meta.title: Overseas exhibitions & export services
meta.description: Market Balance runs overseas trade fair participation, buyer sourcing and matching, and export marketing for Korean SMEs — from planning to contract.

hero.lead: Led by a CEO with 22 years in export marketing and exhibitions, and partners in more than 20 countries, we take care of fair selection, booth operations, buyer meetings and contracts.

services.title: What we do
services.intro: Five services for going overseas. Use one, or hand us the whole project.

items.title: Overseas exhibition support
items.desc: We choose the right fair, handle booth rental, stand building and shipping, and run the booth on site. We also connect you to government support programmes and organise Korea pavilions.

items.title: Buyer sourcing & matching
items.desc: We find buyers from our industry database, confirm their demand in advance, then support one-to-one meetings, interpreting and follow-up contracts.

items.title: SME export marketing
items.desc: Market research and entry strategy, export meetings, trade missions and online B2B promotion to open new overseas sales channels.

items.title: Business event planning
items.desc: Conferences, roadshows and seminars for public bodies and companies, from planning and operations to the final report.

items.title: Trade agency
items.desc: We handle export operations for you, from market research to signing the contract and shipping.

network.title: Overseas network
network.intro: We have regional bases in China, Southeast Asia, Russia, India and the Americas, and work with marketing specialists in each market.
